title: Plants and seeds
examples: What are the different parts of a plant?
What do plants need to grow big and strong?
Can you show me the life cycle of a plant?

explain.say: Look at this picture. Can you see the different parts of a plant?
Now look! Here it is in 3D: how a seed germinates. Can you see the seed and the radicle? Tap any part, and I will tell you about it.
The roots go down into the soil to drink water. The stem holds the plant up tall.
The leaves use sunshine to make food for the plant. Flowers help the plant make seeds.

items: Leaves use sunshine to make food

explain.say: Seeds are tiny things that hold a baby plant inside. To grow, a seed needs soil, water, and sunshine.
First, a seed needs to be planted in the soil. Then, it grows roots down and a little stem up.
When you plant a sunflower seed in a pot, the seed is the beginning. The soil holds it steady until it sprouts. Sunshine helps the baby plant grow big and strong.
A common mistake is thinking seeds grow on their own without care. Remember that seeds need three things to wake up and grow. They need soil, water, and sunshine to start their journey.

faq.q: What do plants use sunshine for?
faq.a: Plants use sunshine to make their own food. This process is very important for them to live.
asks: Does sunshine help plants make food?

faq.q: Are roots the same as the stem?
faq.a: No, the roots stay underground to drink water. The stem is the part that usually stands up above the ground.
asks: What is the difference between roots and stems?

faq.q: What happens after a plant makes seeds?
faq.a: The seeds can fall off and wait for good soil. Then, they can start the whole growing process again.
asks: Can seeds grow into new plants?
What is the next step after seeds?

faq.q: Do plants need air to grow?
faq.a: Yes, plants need air, just like we do. They take in air through their leaves to help them breathe.

faq.q: Can a plant grow without water?
faq.a: No, plants cannot survive for long without water. Water helps the roots drink up everything they need.
asks: What is the most important thing for plants?
Will a plant die without rain?

facts: Plants have roots that anchor them in the soil.
Leaves are important because they help the plant make food.
Seeds are the beginning of a new plant life.
Plants need soil, water, sunshine, and air to grow.

quiz.say: Which part of the plant usually grows underground?
quiz.why: The roots are the parts that anchor the plant and grow down into the soil.

wrong.0: Leaves are the flat parts that catch the sunlight for food.
wrong.1: The flower is the colorful part that helps the plant make seeds.
wrong.3: The stem is the main body that usually stands up above the ground.

quiz.say: What must a seed have to start growing?
quiz.why: A seed needs soil to sit in, water to drink, and sunshine to wake up.

wrong.1: Sunshine is needed, but the seed also needs something to sit in and drink from.
wrong.2: Water helps, but the seed also needs the soil and the sun to start.
wrong.3: Leaves make food, but the seed needs water and sun to begin growing.

quiz.say: What comes after a seed sprouts?
quiz.why: When a seed wakes up, the first thing to come out is a tiny shoot called a sprout.

wrong.0: The plant makes seeds later, after it has grown into a bigger plant.
wrong.1: The roots grow down, but the sprout comes up towards the sunshine.
wrong.3: The flower comes later, after the plant has grown up a little bit.
